snippet.title: UNTURNED | Launch Trailer – Out Now! [ESRB]
snippet.description:
The zombies from UNTURNED are now raiding PlayStation 4 and Xbox One! 

UNTURNED is an open-world survival sandbox where the player assumes the role of survivor in the zombie infested ruins of modern-day society. Form alliances with friends or fight against other players to remain among the living. Survivors must also scavenge for clothes, weapons, food, supplies and craft resources to create equipment, all while avoiding zombies and other players! 

Remain among the living, stay UNTURNED!

For behind the scenes details on all of 505's games, head to the official 505 Games Blog: http://www.505games.com/blog
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/505Games
Twitter: https://twitter.com/505_Games
